open_points.subject: StaffProjectAssignment uniqueness enforced by create_staff_access_schema
open_points.question: Must the staff-assignment schema enforce uniqueness only for active assignments, so a revoked pair can receive the new record promised by assign_staff_project?
options: Replace whole-pair uniqueness with uniqueness restricted to active assignments; revoked history remains and reassignment succeeds.
Keep whole-pair uniqueness; reassignment after revocation fails with PersistenceError, contrary to INV-009 and assign_staff_project.
open_points.default_guess: Enforce uniqueness only among active assignments and retain every revoked assignment.

witness.initial: The schema exists and one StaffProjectAssignment for a staff/project pair is revoked; the pair has no active assignment.
events: An administrator calls assign_staff_project for that staff member and project.
Registry validation succeeds and staff_identity finds no active assignment.
staff_identity attempts to insert the promised new active assignment and its audit.
outcomes: The assign_staff_project obligation and INV-009 return a new active StaffProjectAssignment, preserve the revoked record and commit one audit.
The schema's whole-pair unique constraint rejects the insert as PersistenceError, leaving no new assignment or audit.
witness.observer: The administrator sees success versus HTTP 500, and the operator's next authorization check sees access versus no access.

open_points.subject: ProjectViewerGrant uniqueness enforced by create_client_access_schema
open_points.question: Must the viewer-grant schema enforce uniqueness only for active grants, so a revoked pair can receive the new record promised by grant_viewer_project?
options: Replace whole-pair uniqueness with uniqueness restricted to active grants; revoked history remains and re-granting succeeds.
Keep whole-pair uniqueness; re-granting after revocation fails with PersistenceError, contrary to INV-009 and grant_viewer_project.
open_points.default_guess: Enforce uniqueness only among active viewer grants and retain every revoked grant.

witness.initial: The schema exists and one ProjectViewerGrant for a viewer/project pair is revoked; the pair has no active grant.
events: An administrator calls grant_viewer_project for the active viewer and active project.
Registry validation succeeds and viewer_access finds no active grant.
viewer_access attempts to insert the promised new active grant and its audit.
outcomes: The grant_viewer_project obligation and INV-009 return a new active ProjectViewerGrant, preserve the revoked grant and commit one audit.
The schema's whole-pair unique constraint rejects the insert as PersistenceError, leaving no new grant or audit.
witness.observer: The administrator sees success versus HTTP 500, and the viewer sees the project become accessible versus remain inaccessible.

open_points.subject: ProducerProjectGrant uniqueness enforced by create_producer_identity_schema
open_points.text: (`service_principal_id`, `project_id`) of a grant and (`service_principal_id`, `key_version`) of a credential are unique.
open_points.question: Must the producer-grant part of this schema enforce uniqueness only for active grants while retaining the separate whole-pair credential key-version uniqueness?
options: Restrict only (`service_principal_id`, `project_id`) grant uniqueness to active grants and retain credential key-version uniqueness unchanged.
Keep whole-pair producer-grant uniqueness; granting again after revocation fails with PersistenceError, contrary to INV-009 and grant_producer_project.
open_points.default_guess: Enforce uniqueness only among active producer grants and leave (`service_principal_id`, `key_version`) credential uniqueness unchanged.

witness.initial: The schema exists and one ProducerProjectGrant for a principal/project pair is revoked; the pair has no active grant.
events: An administrator calls grant_producer_project for the principal and active project.
Registry validation succeeds and service_identity finds no active grant.
service_identity attempts to insert the promised new active producer grant and its audit.
outcomes: The grant_producer_project obligation and INV-009 return a new active ProducerProjectGrant, preserve the revoked grant and commit one audit.
The schema's whole-pair grant constraint rejects the insert as PersistenceError, leaving no new grant or audit.
witness.observer: The administrator sees success versus HTTP 500, and a granted-projects producer subsequently receives project scope versus scoped not-found.
